Col.description: Vertical layout. Without gap it spaces blocks like an article.

Row.signature: Row(children: Node[], gap?: number, align?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch", justify?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "between", wrap?: boolean)
Row.description: Horizontal layout; items are vertically centered.

Box.signature: Box(children?: Node[], direction?: "row" | "col", gap?: number, padding?: number, background?: Color, radius?: Radius, border?: boolean, width?: Length, height?: Length, flex?: number, align?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch", justify?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "between", wrap?: boolean)
Box.description: Flex container, a column by default. radius also clips the content.

Grid.signature: Grid(children: Node[], columns?: number, minChildWidth?: number, gap?: number)
Grid.description: Equal columns (default 2). With minChildWidth (px), columns drop on narrow screens.

Card.signature: Card(children: Node[], variant?: "outline" | "soft", padding?: number, gap?: number)
Card.description: Panel with a border; soft is a filled panel for summaries.

Carousel.signature: Carousel(children: Node[], itemWidth?: number, gap?: number)
Carousel.description: Horizontal row that scrolls and snaps, each child an item itemWidth px wide (default 240): photos, cards, options, days.

Popover.signature: Popover(trigger: string | Node[], content: string | Node[])
Popover.description: Shows content in a small panel when the trigger is clicked: a definition, a source, details behind an Icon("info", "sm").

Tabs.signature: Tabs(label: string, tabs: {title: string, content: Node[]}[])
Tabs.description: Keyboard-accessible optional views or scenarios. Put all essential conclusions in visible content outside the tabs.

Spacer.description: Fills the free space in a Row.

Title.signature: Title(text: string, size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" | "2xl" | "3xl", color?: Color, level?: "2" | "3" | "4")
Title.description: Heading. Size is visual; level is 2 by default, 3 for subsections and 4 only within a subsection.

Text.signature: Text(text: string | Node[], size?: "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg", color?: Color, weight?: "normal" | "medium" | "semibold", italic?: boolean, lineThrough?: boolean, tabularNums?: boolean, maxLines?: number)
Text.description: Paragraph; supports **bold**, *italic*, `code` and [links](https://…). text may be a list mixing strings and inline components: [Icon("clock", "sm"), " 25 min · ", Badge("Easy")].

Badge.description: Pill tag; icon is an optional leading lucide name.

List.description: timeline joins the markers with a line.

ListItem.signature: ListItem(title: string, description?: string, marker?: string, children?: Node[])
ListItem.description: marker replaces the bullet or number, e.g. a time or an emoji.

Markdown.description: Prose with headings, lists, quotes, code and tables.

Quote.description: A quotation or a callout with a side rule; cite names the source.

Code.description: Code block with a copy button.

Math.description: LaTeX formula, e.g. Math("E = mc^2"); inline true to sit in a Text list.

Form.description: Groups fields; their values go with any @ToAssistant inside.

Input.signature: Input(value: $binding<string | number>, label?: string, type?: "text" | "number", placeholder?: string)
Input.description: Text or number field; a number field stores numbers.

TextArea.signature: TextArea(value: $binding<string>, label?: string, placeholder?: string, rows?: number)

Slider.signature: Slider(value: $binding<number>, min: number, max: number, step?: number, label?: string, unit?: string, marks?: {value: number, label: string}[])
Slider.description: Shows label and value; unit like "%" or "$" formats the value.

Select.signature: Select(value: $binding<string>, options: (string | {value: string, label: string})[], label?: string, placeholder?: string)

Checkbox.description: lineThrough strikes the label when checked, for to-do lists.

RadioGroup.signature: RadioGroup(value: $binding<string>, options: (string | {value: string, label: string, description?: string})[], label?: string, variant?: "list" | "pills" | "cards")
RadioGroup.description: pills for short choices; cards for choices that need a description line.

SegmentedControl.signature: SegmentedControl(value: $binding<string>, options: (string | {value: string, label: string})[], block?: boolean)
SegmentedControl.description: 2 to 4 short choices in a row.

DatePicker.signature: DatePicker(value: $binding<string>, label?: string, min?: string, max?: string)

Button.signature: Button(label: string, action?: ActionExpression, variant?: "solid" | "outline" | "soft" | "ghost", color?: "primary" | "danger" | "success", size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg", icon?: string, disabled?: boolean, block?: boolean)

IconButton.signature: IconButton(icon: string, action?: ActionExpression, label?: string, variant?: "outline" | "ghost" | "solid")
IconButton.description: Round icon-only button; label is read aloud.

Pressable.signature: Pressable(children: Node[], action?: ActionExpression, selected?: boolean, padding?: number, background?: Color, radius?: Radius)
Pressable.description: Makes any content clickable, such as a tile or a swatch.

Flashcard.signature: Flashcard(front: string | Node[], back: string | Node[], hint?: string)
Flashcard.description: Card that flips between front and back when tapped. Put several in a Carousel or Grid.

Source.description: Link to one source by the exact evidence ID supplied by Xroga. Omit when no IDs were supplied.

Icon.description: A Lucide icon for a label or section. Use only when it aids scanning.

Table.description: Each row lists its cells in column order; a cell may be a component. Number columns align right.

Chart.signature: Chart(type: "bar" | "line" | "area" | "pie" | "donut" | "scatter", data: Record<string, string | number>[], x?: string, series?: string[], format?: "number" | "currency" | "percent", currency?: string, stacked?: boolean, height?: number)
Chart.description: Rows of data; x is the category key (a number key for scatter), series the value keys (default: every number key). percent values are like 45; currency is a code like "EUR".

Svg.signature: Svg(children: Node[], viewBox: string, width?: Length, height?: Length, label?: string)
Svg.description: A drawing for steps, parts, mechanisms, diagrams and layouts. Scales to its width. Provide a descriptive label and nearby prose explaining the relationships.

Circle.signature: Circle(cx: number, cy: number, r: number, fill?: Color, stroke?: Color, strokeWidth?: number, opacity?: number)

Ellipse.signature: Ellipse(cx: number, cy: number, rx: number, ry: number, fill?: Color, stroke?: Color, strokeWidth?: number, opacity?: number)

Rect.signature: Rect(x: number, y: number, width: number, height: number, fill?: Color, stroke?: Color, strokeWidth?: number, opacity?: number, rx?: number)

Line.signature: Line(x1: number, y1: number, x2: number, y2: number, stroke?: Color, strokeWidth?: number, opacity?: number)

Path.signature: Path(d: string, fill?: Color, stroke?: Color, strokeWidth?: number, opacity?: number)

Polyline.signature: Polyline(points: string, stroke?: Color, strokeWidth?: number, fill?: Color, opacity?: number)

Polygon.signature: Polygon(points: string, fill?: Color, stroke?: Color, strokeWidth?: number, opacity?: number)

G.signature: G(children: Node[], transform?: string, opacity?: number)

SvgText.signature: SvgText(text: string, x: number, y: number, size?: number, fill?: Color, anchor?: "start" | "middle" | "end", weight?: "normal" | "medium" | "semibold")

Clamp.signature: Clamp(number: number, min: number, max: number) → number
Clamp.description: number kept between min and max

Convert.signature: Convert(value: number, from: string, to: string) → number
Convert.description: value from one unit to another: mm cm m km in ft yd mi; mg g kg oz lb st; ml l tsp tbsp floz cup pt qt gal (US); m/s km/h mph kn; m2 km2 ft2 ha acre; c f k

Lerp.signature: Lerp(a: number, b: number, t: number) → number
Lerp.description: The value a fraction t of the way from a to b

Payment.signature: Payment(principal: number, rate: number, periods: number) → number
Payment.description: Payment per period that repays principal over periods at rate percent per period, e.g. a 30-year loan at 6% a year: @Payment(300000, 6 / 12, 360)

Percent.description: part / total * 100, e.g. @Percent(3, 4) is 75; 0 when total is 0

Sqrt.description: Square root; null for a negative number

Format.signature: Format(value: number, kind?: "number" | "currency" | "percent" | "compact", decimals?: number, currency?: string) → string
Format.description: Number as text: "number" 12,345.6, "currency" $12,345.68 (currency is a code like "EUR"), "percent" 45 -> 45%, "compact" 1.2M ($1.2M with a currency)

Plural.signature: Plural(n: number, word: string, plural?: string) → string
Plural.description: Count and word: @Plural(1, "guest") is "1 guest", 3 gives "3 guests"; plural defaults to word + "s"
